# TextLayoutLine

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Fonts` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct TextLayoutLine(int Start, int Length, float Width, bool HasEllipsis)
```

A line of a [`TextLayout`](TextLayout.md): which part of the text it shows, and how wide that is.

## Properties

### HasEllipsis

```csharp
public bool HasEllipsis { get; init; }
```

Whether it ends in the layout's ellipsis, as text was cut off.

### Length

```csharp
public int Length { get; init; }
```

How many characters the line shows.

### Start

```csharp
public int Start { get; init; }
```

### Width

```csharp
public float Width { get; init; }
```
